name: Opposite Sex
overview: Scripture clearly defines the created order and distinctions between the opposite sexes, emphasizing the union of man and woman as one flesh in marriage (Genesis 2:24). God prohibits sexual relations between men as an abomination (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13) and forbids crossing gender distinctions in clothing (Deuteronomy 22:5). These commands uphold God's design for gender and sexuality, warning against deception and ungodliness (Galatians 6:3) and illustrating the moral decay seen in Sodom (Genesis 19:4).
